name: deus-witness
description: An outside witness for your agent: every tool call (Bash, Edit, Write, Read, WebFetch, MCP...) is decided by Deus Witness before it runs, with a signed receipt you can check offline.

agent_key.title: Deus Witness agent key
agent_key.description: Shown once when you create an agent (claude-code preset) at https://witness.sipkigroup.com. Empty = the key saved by /deus-witness:try (deus-witness try) is used; none at all = calls are not witnessed (the plugin says so).

strict.title: Strict without a key
strict.description: On: while no agent key is set, every matched tool call is denied. Off (default): the plugin does nothing until configured.
